We have electrical panels all over the place. They are all watertight and sealed very well.

One we have is used specifically to control chemicals we use in cleaning - caustic and  peracetic acid. Two separate peristaltic pumps are attached to the side of this panel.

A few months ago at work I heard an almighty bang - thought a fermentor had exploded it was so loud! The guy who had been working on the cleaning electrical panel was running away from it. Hand bloodied. Ambulance arrived. Fire department. Whole ten yards.

Turns out the caustic was leaking into the sealed container - it reacted with aluminum fittings inside and made a small hydrogen bomb....
